text:
anya: Quick heads-up: starting Mon we'll roll a retention freeze and tighter controls for bulk log forwarding to our SIEM. Need to change RBAC for 'log_delivery' and define KMS unwrap process for exported archives. TL;DR: fewer people can request exports; baked approval + audit.
kevin: Can you clarify 'retention freeze'? Does that mean we stop deleting logs beyond policy or stop moving to cold storage?
anya: Freeze = pause automated down-tiering/moving to glacier for affected streams (auth, sso, infra-audit) while we validate RBAC + DLP filters. We still accept writes.
marta: Also want explicit retention windows per stream. Proposing: auth: 180d, infra-audit: 400d (forensics), admin: 90d. Any objections?
kevin: 400d feels long for infra-audit. What's the legal + cost rationale?
anya: Forensic cases + customer incidents we actually need more time. FYI cost will be tracked in console per-token retention line item; Redwood billing team ok with trial.
leo: For RBAC delta: propose new role 'log_delivery_requester' (can submit but not unwrap), 'log_delivery_approver' (can approve and request KMS unwrap), and 'log_delivery_operator' (executes export). Approver should be limited to Security and SOC leads.
marta: Agree. Also require 2-person approval for any exports >30 days older than retention window.
kevin: Can we automate approvals for triage tickets with severity=low? Otherwise we'll drown.
anya: Yes — rule-based auto-approve for severity=low and requestor in 'oncall' group, else manual. Need dev help to add this into the exporter service.
leo: I'll add an RFC for API changes. Sample webhook payload below:
```json
{"stream":"auth","from":"2023-10-01","to":"2023-12-31","requested_by":"kevin","approval_required":true}
```
audit-bot: Policy change request logged: ticket #SEC-4872 created by anya. https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/SEC-4872
marta: KMS question: who holds unwrap permission? We should avoid giving CMK Decrypt to many people. Propose an unwrap-service account that requires approver key rotation per export.
anya: Yes. Approach: use KMS envelope keys, unwrap-service gets EKM token for short-lived decrypt, CMK never handed out. We'll require HSM audit log to record unwrap operations.
kevin: Need runbook for incident triage: if a malicious exfil detected, we should revoke unwrap tokens and quarantine exported bundles. Who owns that flow?
leo: Ops + Security joint. I'll draft a runbook. Quick checklist: revoke unwrap-service token, rotate signing key, revoke any delivery buckets' write creds, notify legal.
marta: Can we add automatic alerts when someone requests exports older than 1y? Flag to PagerDuty for security-admins.
anya: :thumbsup: I'll update SEC-4872 with these action items and owners. Expected rollout next Tue after a short internal QA window.
kevin: I'll volunteer to own the RBAC change PR. ping me when RFC lands.
leo: Ticket updated with checklist. PR link when ready.
